Installed Lando exposes `push-commits`, not `lando land`; use `lando push-commits --help` to verify `--local-repo`, `--lando-repo`, `--branch`, `--relbranch`, `--base-commit`, and `--yes`. Default Lando repo is `thunderbird-desktop-main`, configurable through `config.lando.repo`. [Task 1]
